messages.body:
Hi Natalie,
Thank you for following up and for sending over the details.
We already have a band that performs every Saturday night, so unfortunately, we wouldn't be looking to book any additional entertainment at the moment.
As far as I'm aware, any payments for entertainment bookings would need to be processed through our approved company, GigRealm.
Thank you again for reaching out.
Kind regards,
Ben
